# UPSC Notes

> Free, offline-first markdown notes app for UPSC Civil Services preparation.
> Notes are stored in the browser (IndexedDB) and backed up to each student's own
> Google Drive. Students can publish selected notes at upscnotes.hashin.me/<username>.

Hosting: Cloudflare Pages (static) + one Pages Function + D1 + R2.
The function only verifies Google identity and keeps the username registry unique.
Note content never touches the server — the browser reads/writes Google Drive directly.

- Source: https://github.com/hashin/upscnotes
- Setup: /docs/SETUP.md in the repo
